issue.title: Close the research report commit gap
issue.description: Every research-macro report lands in a checkout the host commits. A run that writes into a checkout the commit finalizer does not scan is told so before it stops. The ten reports already stranded in apollo's primary research checkouts get committed.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202611/research_commit_gap.md requests this work

payload.entry: PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Resolve the general launch-time cwd hazard with the sase-1tc land agent — since efc66a420b, cwd-dependent commands in macro bodies (for example sase repo path, git rev-parse, pwd) run against the runner cwd before workspace claim. Consider entering the known workspace before expansion for non-deferred launches, or delaying authored commands until after claim.

unscanned-write-guard done and verified: new commit_scan_roots helper plus find_unscanned_writes detector (tool-call writes, explicit-artifact sources, extra_paths; toplevel-equality vs scan roots; dirty check; open/open_and_move/relocate_or_discard fix with repo-relative path; fail-open); surfaced as advisory top-level unscanned_writes in sase final context (wire/requirements/obligations/digests unchanged), step 2 of /sase_final, repo-relative rule in /sase_repo, and warn-branch stderr warning in sase artifact create -p (exit unchanged; artifact still registers); parser help + generated artifact.md + finalizers.md docs updated. Verified: 13/13 new tests in tests/test_unscanned_writes_guard.py pass; 77 affected tests pass (finalizer channel context, final prepare/status, artifact handler, artifact create, dirty-repo dedupe/reserved-paths, followup inheritance); ruff/mypy/symvision/fmt clean; sase tool run check lint stages all green incl. symvision (run 1f27f18dcdc719886b71631fe5008b61; its test lane was still sweeping on an overloaded host at hand-off). No epic-symbol leftovers. Note: redeploy generated skills (sase skill init) from the landed tree after landing; not run from this workspace per generated_skills note.
